subject: Cloud Computing
title: On-Demand Self-Service
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on On-Demand Self-Service.

hook.text: Need 50 servers right now? In the old world, that took weeks of purchase orders and shipping.

buildup.text: Cloud computing lets you provision resources instantly, without calling anyone or signing a contract.

discovery.text: NIST defined five traits of cloud. On-demand self-service is number one: you serve yourself.

twist.text: This simplicity hides complexity. Behind one click, thousands of automated systems coordinate.

climax.text: Self-service changed the power dynamic. Developers no longer wait for IT to approve hardware.

punchline.text: The cloud's first promise: get what you need, when you need it.

quiz.question: What does 'on-demand self-service' mean in cloud computing?
options: Users can provision resources instantly without human intervention
Cloud providers send technicians to set up servers on demand
Services are only available during business hours

details.summary: On-demand self-service means you can provision cloud resources through a web console, CLI, or API without human intervention from the provider. In minutes, you can launch servers, create databases, and configure networks entirely through automated interfaces.
details.whyItMatters: Self-service provisioning eliminates the weeks-long procurement cycles of traditional IT. It enables developers to experiment, iterate, and deploy at the speed of software rather than hardware.
takeaways: Resources are provisioned through consoles, CLIs, and APIs
No human interaction with the provider is required
Provisioning takes minutes instead of weeks or months

faq.question: What is infrastructure as code?
faq.answer: Infrastructure as code defines cloud resources in configuration files that can be version-controlled, reviewed, and deployed automatically. Tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, and Pulumi make infrastructure reproducible, auditable, and consistent across environments.

faq.question: Is self-service provisioning risky?
faq.answer: Without governance, self-service can lead to cost overruns, security violations, and resource sprawl. Organizations mitigate this with policies, budgets, tagging requirements, and approved resource catalogs that provide self-service within guardrails.
